capabilities.name: Run an AI agent in chat for your business
capabilities.question: Can a business run an AI agent that sells and supports customers in a chat app?

US.note: Meta began opening Meta Business Agent to businesses of all sizes globally on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram in June 2026, and Google's Business Agent chat in Search is live for US retailers.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent
New tech and tools for retailers to succeed in an agentic shopping era

GB.note: Meta says businesses of all sizes can use Meta Business Agent globally. But WhatsApp's product page says it is "available to eligible businesses in select markets, with additional markets launching soon." No source we checked names the UK. Meta's developer docs say a business must be in an authorized country, but publish no list. 360dialog says the regional limits appear lifted, but it does not name the UK. The UK stays limited until a source names it.

KR.note: Kakao officially launched Kanana Customer Manager for KakaoTalk Channels in September 2025, and it is open to all channels. It answers customers from store details, menus and posts. Meta Business Agent on WhatsApp is not confirmed for Korea.

SG.note: Meta's June 2026 announcement expanded Meta Business Agent to businesses of all sizes globally. capabilities.name: Pay a business without leaving the chat
capabilities.question: Can a customer pay an agent or business without leaving the chat?

US.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats, which few businesses offer. WhatsApp payments are not launched in the US.

GB.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats, which few businesses offer. WhatsApp payments are not launched in the UK.

DE.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats, which few businesses offer. Apple's page does not list the countries it covers. WhatsApp payments are not offered in Germany.

BR.note: The WhatsApp Payments API for Brazil lets businesses send an order in chat that the customer pays by Pix code, card, boleto or payment link, although the Pix flow still hands off to the bank app and only works with Brazilian numbers. Telegram bot payments through Stripe also work.

MX.note: Only a niche channel: Telegram bot payments through Stripe work for Mexican businesses. WhatsApp payments are not launched in Mexico.

CL.note: No mainstream way to pay inside a chat was found: WhatsApp payments are not offered in Chile, and Stripe, the main Telegram payment provider, does not sign up businesses there.

CO.note: dale!, Grupo Aval's digital wallet, lets its customers pay utility and other bills they have enrolled in the app from its WhatsApp channel, and send Bre-B transfers there, since October 2026. It works only for dale! customers and enrolled bills, and only the press covers the bill payments so far. WhatsApp's own payments are still not offered in Colombia.

evidence.title: dale! evoluciona su experiencia financiera en WhatsApp: ahora suma el pago de servicios públicos y privados

IN.note: WhatsApp Pay runs on UPI, and the WhatsApp Payments API lets businesses take UPI, card and netbanking payments in chat through BillDesk, Razorpay, PayU or Zaakpay.

evidence.title: Receive payments via payment gateways on WhatsApp

ES.note: Only Telegram bot payments through Stripe, a niche channel. Apple Messages for Business was not listed for Spain, and WhatsApp payments are not offered in Spain.

evidence.title: Apple Business Chat Expands Beyond United States to 10 Countries and 30 More Brands (Spain not listed)

FR.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats, which few businesses offer. Apple's page names no countries. WhatsApp payments are not offered in France.

evidence.title: Apple Business Chat Expands Beyond United States to 10 Countries and 30 More Brands (France included)

CA.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, which serves Canadian businesses, and Apple Messages for Business, which reached Canada in 2018 but which few brands offer. WhatsApp payments are not offered in Canada.

evidence.title: Apple Business Chat Expands Beyond United States to 10 Countries and 30 More Brands

JP.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, which serves Japan. LINE Pay closed in Japan in April 2025, which also ended LINE Official Account payments. PayPay in LINE, announced 2 July 2026, sends money and splits bills between people, not to businesses. We searched LINE Yahoo and PayPay sources for business payments in LINE and found none (Nov 2026).

evidence.title: LINE公式アカウントのLINE Pay決済機能が終了！対処法は？
LINEでPayPayが使える (送金・割り勘)

AU.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through a payment provider, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats, which few businesses offer. WhatsApp payments are not launched in Australia: Meta's pages name no country, and the only sign of Australia is an unreleased WhatsApp settings screen in a secondhand report (Nov 2026).

NG.note: Paystack Index (early access, June 2026, Nigeria only) lets ChatGPT or Claude start payments for selected Zap users, but coverage does not say where the final approval happens. Payaza's Chat & Pay (April 2026) gives merchants a WhatsApp number where buyers pay in the chat, according to launch coverage; Payaza's own page was not opened. WhatsApp's own payments are not offered in Nigeria. We searched Paystack, Payaza and WhatsApp payments (Nov 2026); Paystack's site blocks scripts.

evidence.title: Payaza Launches 'Chat & Pay' Feature for instant WhatsApp payments

KR.note: Kakao said on its May 2026 earnings call that it will launch a KakaoTalk AI agent. The agent takes a user from search and recommendations to payment inside a chat. The formal launch is planned for the second half of 2026, and a gift-shopping version is in beta. We found no launch notice by late November 2026, and no way to pay a Korean business inside KakaoTalk or Naver TalkTalk today.

evidence.title: 검색부터 결제까지 카톡 안에서…카카오 AI 에이전트 나온다

SG.note: WhatsApp payments with Stripe opened in Singapore in May 2023 to a small number of businesses. Buyers can pay by card or PayNow. Stripe's 2023 announcement is the latest source we found, and we found no 2026 update, so the flag stays. Telegram bot payments through Stripe are another niche route.

evidence.title: WhatsApp and Stripe help Singapore businesses accept payments directly in chats

ID.note: We found no way to pay a business inside a chat app in Indonesia. WhatsApp's payment API is listed for India only.

IT.note: We could not confirm any way for an Italian customer to pay a business inside a chat app. Telegram's bot payments page names no countries, so Italy is unconfirmed, and we did not check WhatsApp Pay or Apple Messages for Italy.

NL.note: The only route I could confirm is Telegram bot payments through Stripe, which Stripe supports for Dutch accounts. Telegram's bot payment rules name no country limits. I found no WhatsApp payment feature for Dutch businesses, and no sign that many Dutch businesses take payments in chat.

AE.note: A 2021 launch let UAE merchants collect payments through WhatsApp. It used Payit, the wallet from First Abu Dhabi Bank, and PLATX. We found no 2026 source that it still runs. We found no other way for a UAE customer to pay a business inside WhatsApp, Telegram or Apple Messages.

evidence.title: WhatsApp Enabled Transactions to be Supported in UAE with Assistance from First Abu Dhabi Bank and PLATX

SA.note: No way to pay a business inside a chat app in Saudi Arabia turned up. WhatsApp's in-chat payment providers are all Indian (BillDesk, Razorpay, PayU, Zaakpay) and the currency is INR only, and Stripe does not list Saudi Arabia. I did not check Apple Pay in Messages for Business for Saudi Arabia.

evidence.title: Receive payments via payment gateways on WhatsApp

ZA.note: We found no way to pay a business inside a chat app in South Africa. WhatsApp's payment gateway guide names only India, Telegram's bot payments name no South African provider, and Apple's Business Chat page lists no countries.

evidence.title: Receive payments via payment gateways on WhatsApp

KE.note: Only bank chatbots offer payment inside a chat in Kenya. Equity's EVA chatbot on WhatsApp could pay bills and buy goods when it launched in 2022, but I found no shop that takes payment in its own chat, and current availability was not confirmed.

evidence.title: Equity virtual assistant chat banking platform

AR.note: Banco Macro's MacroChat, launched in August 2026, lets customers pay bills and top up phones inside WhatsApp. That covers bank bill payments only, and we found no WhatsApp Pay or shop checkout inside chat in Argentina.
